text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three――all right! Everyone's 
here!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, please take us there, 
driver!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's going to take a little while to get 
to the academy, so I prepared a little 
boxed lunch for you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Take one each and pass 'em around!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Look at you being so thoughtful, 
Hishiama! Thanks a bunch~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...The sausages are shaped like octopuses. 
Your attention to detail is as sharp as 
ever.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now then—another year wrapped up safely. 
I'm just glad nobody got hurt.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I haven't done anything special. *Yawn*... 
Besides, all the Miho girls are honest, 
good kids.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
If I had just spoken up properly... you 
would have listened right away...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps she woke up early in the 
morning to make this bento for you."

And so, the passionate summer training 
camp with Hishi Amazon came to an end.
